title: CS & Sales Launch Kit: Prioritization, Demo Scenarios, and Rapid Reference Sheets
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Create a lightweight, modular enablement kit for Sales and Customer Success focused on the upcoming runtime-1.19 release and associated cost/latency features. Deliverables include rapid reference sheets, persona-based demo scenarios, two-minute elevator pitches, objection-handling matrices, and three polished demo scripts that showcase tradeoffs (batching, caching, quantization) for lead conversations.
acceptance_criteria: Three demo scripts (15–20 minute full demo, 7–8 minute quick demo, 3–4 minute executive demo) reviewed by a Solutions Engineer and one AE and marked 'field-tested'.

Six one-page rapid reference sheets (Quick Stats, Cost/Latency Tradeoffs, Common Objections & Responses, Deployment Options, Rollout/Failure Modes, Security & Compliance FAQs) uploaded to the Enablement library.
One consolidated battlecard (two-sided PDF) per persona (Platform Engineer, Product Manager, Chief Architect) with clear success criteria and pricing impact examples.
All assets reviewed by Design and Docs; copy edits completed; release notes team notified with approved summary blurb.
